_help: Copy to verification/<case-id>.json and fill by hand. Master Plan §6.8. build_case.py --stage verify copies it to cases/<case-id>/verification.json. The explanation and caveat are HUMAN PROSE — never generated. Delete this _help key in the real file.

official_finding.summary: One or two sentences: what the official investigation concluded, in plain language.

responsible_parties.name: VESSEL OR ENTITY NAME
responsible_parties.role: e.g. initiating anchor strike / discharging vessel / salvage operator

official_finding.source_name: e.g. NTSB Marine Investigation Report MIR-24-01
official_finding.source_url: https://... (must be present and non-empty — this is the 'is this real?' link)
official_finding.caveat: The single most important qualifier. e.g. the anchor strike preceded the release by eight months, so no vessel was the proximate source at detection time.

udgam_result.origin_summary: Filled from the actual output files AFTER the stages run. Where the origin cloud landed, distance to the reported leak location, key radii.
top_suspects: mmsi or source name, as it appears in suspects.json

assessment.explanation: HUMAN-WRITTEN PROSE. Why this verdict. A miss with an honest explanation of why reads as engineering; only-hits reads as marketing.
assessment.what_would_have_helped: What extra data or a finer model would have changed the result. Optional but recommended.
